run_kilt_fever_main: run the main function to generate k-shot data for the KILT FEVER dataset with multiple seeds
create_kilt_fever_dataset: create a Kilt_Fever dataset instance to load and preprocess the KILT FEVER dataset from HuggingFace
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with tab-separated answers
load_kilt_fever_dataset: load the KILT FEVER dataset from HuggingFace using the kilt_tasks fever configuration
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, development, and test splits for few-shot learning with configurable seed and k value
